customManagers.description: Bump FREERADIUS_VERSION in .freeradius-version when upstream publishes a new release. The workflow derives the upstream git tag, the published image tag, and the post-build version assertion from this one value.

packageRules.description: Track upstream's own Docker Hub tags as the release signal — a tag there means the release_X_Y_Z git tag exists, which is what we actually build from. Restrict to the 3.2 stable series: 4.x is a separate development branch and moving to it must be a deliberate, tested decision, not a Renovate PR. The regex also excludes the `-alpine` variant tags.
